title: Step 4 - Creating a Dependent Variable from K-Means Clustering Results in Python

cues.en: -: All right my friend, I hope you had no trouble at all to train that K-Means model on the data set in order to identify that optimal five number of clusters
cues.zh: 講師：好，朋友，希望你很順利地用資料集訓練 K-means 模型，辨識出最佳的五個群組。

cues.en: which we figured out thanks to the Elbow method because indeed in order to do this, you just had to do exactly the same as what we did here
cues.zh: 這個最佳數量是透過手肘法找出的；要做到這件事，其實只需要和這裡一樣，

cues.en: inside this loop by just replacing that I number of classes here, which is the iterative variable by five.
cues.zh: 把迴圈內群組數量的迭代變數 i 換成 5。

cues.en: Because now we know that we want to build, train and run the K-Means algorithm to identify five clusters.
cues.zh: 因為現在知道，我們要建立、訓練並執行 K-means 演算法，來辨識五個群組。

cues.en: And therefore here we're simply going to take these two lines of code and we're gonna paste that right below
cues.zh: 所以直接取這兩行程式碼，貼到下面，

cues.en: in a new code cell to indeed train our K-Means model to identify five clusters, all right?
cues.zh: 新的程式碼儲存格裡，訓練 K-means 模型來辨識五個群組，好嗎？

cues.en: And we don't have to import the K-Means class again because this was imported here, you know, right here.
cues.zh: 不用再次匯入 KMeans 類別，因為已經在這裡匯入了，就在這裡。

cues.en: And this cell was already executed so no problem at all here we can just call this class directly and input here of course not I clusters, but five clusters to identify.
cues.zh: 這個儲存格也執行過，所以直接呼叫類別就好；這裡當然不是輸入 i 個群組，而是要辨識的五個群組。

cues.en: And same still, we use the K-Means++ Int method to avoid a random initialization trap.
cues.zh: 一樣使用 K-means++ 初始化方法，避免隨機初始化陷阱。

cues.en: And we keep a random state of 42 in order for us to have the same result displayed on our Notebook.
cues.zh: random_state 也維持 42，讓我們的筆記本顯示相同結果。

cues.en: And now this line of code actually indeed trains the K-Means model on the data set to identify five clusters.
cues.zh: 這行程式碼確實會在資料集上訓練 K-means 模型，辨識五個群組。

cues.en: But as I told you in the previous tutorial we also want to do something else which is to build that dependent variable finally
cues.zh: 不過上一堂提過，我們還想做另一件事，就是終於要建立那個應變數，

cues.en: of which the values are exactly these clusters from one to five.
cues.zh: 它的值就代表一到五這些群組。

cues.en: So actually, the values of this dependent variable will be one, two, three, four, five.
cues.zh: 所以這個應變數的值會是 1、2、3、4、5。

cues.en: One will be let's say cluster one, two will be cluster two, three will be cluster three, four will be cluster four, and five will be cluster five.
cues.zh: 假設 1 代表第一群，2 代表第二群，3 代表第三群，4 代表第四群，5 代表第五群。

cues.en: And each of these clusters will actually be a certain group of customers because remember that our data set is composed of customers which will actually be grouped
cues.zh: 每個群組實際上都是某一群顧客，因為記得資料集由顧客組成，他們會被分組，

cues.en: or segmented into these clusters, these five clusters.
cues.zh: 或區隔到這五個群組中。

cues.en: And so there you go, that dependent variable which we're about to create, will split through its values while all these customers into different groups.
cues.zh: 因此，即將建立的應變數，會透過不同的值，把所有顧客分成不同群組。

cues.en: And so there you go, that's our next step here.
cues.zh: 這就是接下來的步驟。

cues.en: How are we going to create that dependent variable?
cues.zh: 要怎麼建立這個應變數呢？

cues.en: Well, I'm gonna show you a little trick.
cues.zh: 我來示範一個小技巧。

cues.en: If you look at the API of cycle learn four K-Means, the K-Means class, well, you will notice that there is actually a fit_predict method.
cues.zh: 查看 scikit-learn 的 KMeans 類別 API，會發現其實有一個 fit_predict 方法。

cues.en: And that fit predict method not only trains your K-Means model on the dataset, but also it returns exactly that dependent variable
cues.zh: fit_predict 不僅會在資料集上訓練 K-means 模型，也會傳回我們即將建立的那個應變數，

cues.en: which we're about to create with the five different values taken by that variable, you know, one, two, thee, four, five which of course correspond to these five different clusters
cues.zh: 這個變數會取五個不同值，1、2、3、4、5，當然分別對應五個不同群組，

cues.en: containing different groups of customers, and in each group while the customers are grouped by similarities.
cues.zh: 包含不同顧客群，而且每一群裡的顧客都是按照相似性分在一起。

cues.en: They contain similar information in each group.
cues.zh: 每一群裡的資訊相似。

cues.en: And in the next step, when visualizing the clusters, you will perfectly understand what will be exactly these information but I don't wanna reveal them now.
cues.zh: 下一步把群組視覺化時，你就會完全了解這些資訊究竟是什麼，但現在先不揭曉。

cues.en: So we're just going to create that dependent variable for now.
cues.zh: 目前先建立這個應變數。

cues.en: And since, as I've just told you while this Fit predict method returns that dependent variable, well, we're gonna create a new variable here which we're gonna call y_kmeans.
cues.zh: 剛才說過，fit_predict 方法會傳回這個應變數，所以在這裡建立一個新變數，命名為 y_kmeans。

cues.en: Here with this line of code, calling the fit break method we create indeed this dependent variable resulting from training our K-Means algorithm
cues.zh: 透過這行程式碼呼叫 fit_predict 方法，就建立了這個應變數，它來自訓練 K-means 演算法，

cues.en: with five clusters, to identify five clusters, okay?
cues.zh: 使用五個群組，辨識五個群組，好嗎？

cues.en: So let's see if this works.
cues.zh: 來看看是否能成功。

cues.en: Let's run the cell to train the K-Means algorithm to identify five clusters.
cues.zh: 執行這個儲存格，訓練 K-means 演算法，辨識五個群組。

cues.en: And all good, it was run properly.
cues.zh: 很好，執行正常。

cues.en: And now I'm just going to show you what we just created.
cues.zh: 現在來看看剛才建立了什麼。

cues.en: Y_kmeans, so I'm gonna input here y_kmeans inside this print, there you go.
cues.zh: y_kmeans，所以在這裡的 print 裡輸入 y_kmeans，就是這樣。

cues.en: Let's run it and let's see what we created.
cues.zh: 執行看看建立的結果。

cues.en: And well, there you go.
cues.zh: 好了。

cues.en: You can see now all the different clusters to which belongs each customer.
cues.zh: 現在可以看到每位顧客分別屬於哪個群組。

cues.en: So here you have to read it this way.
cues.zh: 這裡要這樣解讀。

cues.en: The first customer belongs to cluster three, so that's actually customer id number one.
cues.zh: 第一位顧客屬於群組 3，也就是顧客 ID 為 1 的人。

cues.en: Customer id number one belongs to cluster three, and actually it belongs to cluster number four because this is only the index of the cluster.
cues.zh: 顧客 ID 1 屬於群組 3，其實是第四個群組，因為這個數字只是群組的索引。

cues.en: And remember that indexes in Python start from zero so here actually the numbers of the clusters are zero, one, two, three, and four so let's be careful what we say with them.
cues.zh: 記得 Python 索引從 0 開始，所以群組編號其實是 0、1、2、3、4，說明時要小心。

cues.en: So let's do it again.
cues.zh: 我們重新來一次。

cues.en: Customer id number one belongs to the fourth cluster, then customer id number two belongs to the first cluster.
cues.zh: 顧客 ID 1 屬於第四個群組，顧客 ID 2 屬於第一個群組。

cues.en: Customer id number three belongs to the fourth cluster and et cetera.
cues.zh: 顧客 ID 3 屬於第四個群組，依此類推。

cues.en: And the last customer id belongs to, well, I have to go to the second page here.
cues.zh: 最後一位顧客屬於……我得切到第二頁。

cues.en: There you go, the customer id number 200 belongs to the third cluster or cluster of index two.
cues.zh: 好了，顧客 ID 200 屬於第三個群組，也就是索引為 2 的群組。

cues.en: All right, so there you go.
cues.zh: 好，就是這樣。

cues.en: That's the dependent variable that is created through the training of the K-Means algorithm.
cues.zh: 這就是透過訓練 K-means 演算法建立的應變數。

cues.zh: 年收入，也就是第一個特徵。

cues.en: And on the Y axis, the spending score.
cues.zh: Y 軸則是消費分數。

cues.en: And we will see how our different customers, the different customers of the mall were grouped into these clusters and we're gonna clearly see
cues.zh: 我們會看到購物中心的不同顧客是如何被分到這些群組，也會清楚看到

cues.en: the different clusters and their centroid from one to five.
cues.zh: 這五個群組及各自的質心。
